correctness.rationale: Coordinate reflection makes the sign-product mask orthogonal to all monomials of degree <2m, so the compressed sign operator vanishes for L<m. At L=m only the squarefree monomial involving exactly the 2m selected coordinates contributes. The harmonic degree-m monomials x_I form an orthogonal summand; only complementary I and I^c couple. Normalized spherical Dirichlet moments E x_I^2=Gamma(d/2)/(2^m Gamma(d/2+m)) and E product|x_j|=Gamma(d/2)/(pi^m Gamma(d/2+m)) give rho=(2/pi)^m. The complement involution yields equal ±rho eigenspaces, with the stated residual dimension and positive ratio; boundary d=2m and m>=2 checked.
